abstract: Maintains heavy haul road surveys and site transport access assessments
system_message:
You are the Access logistics lead (LOGIST), responsible for maintaining heavy haul road surveys and site transport access assessments across geothermal exploration sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Heavy equipment staging area（STG）
information_points.content:
LOGIST-STG-VXT：According to the site civil engineering survey for Solstice Caldera Basin, the rig laydown pad surface area across the primary rig assembly yard provides 5000 m^2 of compacted gravel staging area rated for drilling module storage.
LOGIST-STG-Y4L：According to the site civil engineering survey for Thermal Ridge Sector, the rig laydown pad surface area at the primary rig assembly yard encompasses 6500 m^2 of compacted gravel staging area rated for drilling module storage.
LOGIST-STG-13H：According to the site civil engineering survey for Pinnacle Fault Graben, the rig laydown pad surface area within the primary rig assembly yard measures 3500 m^2 of compacted gravel staging area rated for drilling module storage.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy haul road surveys and site transport access assessments（CORR）
information_points.content:
LOGIST-CORR-7W8：For Pinnacle Fault Graben, the route transport feasibility review reports that the heavy haul access road minimum width on the primary access spur connecting the state highway to the drill pad is 8.0 m, as measured at the narrowest surfaced road width for heavy drill rig transport convoys.
LOGIST-CORR-RJ1：For Thermal Ridge Sector, the route transport feasibility review establishes that the heavy haul access road minimum width along the primary access spur connecting the state highway to the drill pad is 9.5 m, based on the narrowest surfaced road width accommodating heavy drill rig transport convoys.
LOGIST-CORR-71O：For Solstice Caldera Basin, the route transport feasibility review indicates that the heavy haul access road minimum width along the primary access spur connecting the state highway to the drill pad is 8.0 m, representing the narrowest surfaced road width accommodating heavy drill rig transport convoys.
